title: IntentGate verify result
description: The output of `intentgate verify --format json`, schema intentgate.verify/1. The same inputs give byte-identical output: every list is sorted by a stable key (locks by path, findings by path then status, suspect reasons and problems alphabetically; criteria keep the lock's own order) and there is no time, host or duration. Every key is always present.

outcome.description: skipped: the author is a bot. no-lock: no lock file added or changed. clean: every changed path is inside a footprint and no lock is suspect. findings: a path is outside every footprint, or a lock is suspect. unverifiable: a lock or .intentgate.yml could not be verified.

exit_code.description: skipped, no-lock and clean: 0. findings: 1. unverifiable: 3.

problems.description: Problems with the configuration (.intentgate.yml or .gitattributes), which make the outcome unverifiable. Lock problems are under locks.

id.description: Empty when the file could not be parsed.

problems.description: Why the lock is unverifiable; when not empty the lock contributes no criteria.
